collection.title: SEAT Alhambra 2001 to 2010 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the SEAT Alhambra 2001 to 2010 will fit, this model requires a 28" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side. This model uses the Side Pin arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Alhambra which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
